hero.title: Siyalemukela eConcepts Learning Academy
hero.subtitle: Lapho ingqondo zabatsha zikhuliswa zibe ngabakhokheli, abasunguli labaguquli bakusasa.

learning.title: Ukufunda Kuqala Lathi
learning.p1: EConcepts Learning Academy, sinika indawo esekelayo lekhuthazayo ukuze abafundi bafunde, bakhule njalo baphumelele. Uthando lwethu lwemfundo ludlula imiphumela emihle: sakha abacabangi abalesibindi, abadalayo, abalungele ikusasa.
learning.p2: Kusukela kuForm 1 kusiya ku-A Level, abafundi bethu baphuma belesimilo, ukuziphatha lamakhono okuguqula umhlaba.

director.title: Kusuka Etafuleni Lomphathisikolo
director.quote: EConcepts Learning Academy, sikholwa ukuthi umfundi ngamunye ulesipho esikhethekileyo. Umsebenzi wethu yikondla lesosipho ngokuziphatha, ukholo, ukusebenza nzima lothando lolwazi.
director.body: Uyemukelwa emphakathini wethu wesikolo. Kanye labafundisi bethu abazinikeleyo, abazali abasekelayo labafundi abalethemba, sakha isikolo lapho ubungcweti bemfundo buhamba lesimilo esiqinileyo.

curriculum.title: Ukubuka Ikharikhulamu
curriculum.intro: IConcepts Learning Academy inika bonke abafundi bethu ikharikhulamu ebanzi lelinganisiweyo ebalungiselela impilo.

about.title: Nge-Concepts Learning Academy
about.subtitle: Iminyaka yokukhulisa ingqondo zabatsha zibe ngabakhokheli labasunguli.
about.history1: IConcepts Learning Academy, isikolo esidumileyo, sasungulwa ngoJanuwari 1927 njengesikolo sokuqala sobuchwepheshe elizweni.
about.history2: Isikolo sathola isimo sesekondari ngo-1931 sasusela endaweni yaso yakhathesi ngo-1953. Saqanjwa kutsha ngokuthi yiConcepts Learning Academy ngo-19 Agasti 1961, sabuya safinyezwa saba yiConcepts Learning Academy ngo-1974.
about.history3: Lamuhla, silabafundi abangaphezu kuka-800, siqhubeka lelifa lobungcweti kwezemfundo lezemidlalo.
